answer: Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the signal queue while genuine members promoted earlier continues earning. The ridge index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1335 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the nebula. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
